lines: While Kuroki Shizuku, seeking to kill me, was on a rampageー
After passing through a mountain path overgrown with trees, we suddenly arrived at an open area.
Two waterfalls, each about 10 meters high, plunged down with great force, creating a refreshing froth.
The natural cool breeze, unlike that of an air conditioner, made the sweat from hiking in the mountains quickly recede.
I was now surrounded by sheer cliffs, moss-covered rocks of all sizes, and a deep pool where I was sure there was some monster fish dwelling in its depths.
This was a so-called secluded spot, which wasn't marked on any maps.
In Gosha Village, it had long been known as the "Ascetic's Valley," and it was a perfect spot for children to play in the river.
The name was said to come from the well-known Enno Ozuno, the founder of mountain asceticism, having trained here with a certain Taimanin whose name was no longer passed down.
It was a place that I'd often come to play as a child as well.
...I haven't been here in a while.
When was the last time I'd come here?
I unintentionally closed my eyes to the nostalgic sound of the waterfall and thought back on distant memories.
It definitely had to be... that time.
It was after my father, Fuma Danjo, had led the rebellion and then been defeated.
It was summer then as well.
I'd often been depressed, and Hebiko had brought me here by force.
Gaiza and Jyubei had also come with.
I no longer remembered what we talked about or what we did here.
As I gave a bitter laugh at myself having become uncharacteristically sentimental...
I opened my eyes at the strangely familiar sounds of excessively loud flapping wings and the drive of a laser blade.
And it was no wonder they were so familiar.
The  Ascetic's Valley apparently already had some visitors. And having found me both of them came rushing over, one flying and one running.
It was the Yatagarasu child, sister to that troublesome little critter Minasaki, as well as Clear.
What gives? You were playing here?
Clear nodded with a sweet smile.
I spoke to the Yatagarasu child.
I heard you're being taken care of at Yukikaze's place lately. So that's how you became friends with Clear?
The Yatagarasu child flapped her wings, surely in affirmation.
It seemed she was called Yata-chan. As one would expect.
This Yata-chan had first come to live at my house after that kidnapping fiasco,
but she'd left soon after, probably because she'd been at wit's end from the nagging Tokiko.
At any rate, she was Minasaki's family.
As such, I'd assumed that she had flown off on her own somewhere. But then I heard from Yukikaze that she was at her house.
She was the second lodger there after Clear. Yukikaze was surprisingly caring.
I'm happy to play, but what's with the weapon?
I was awfully concerned about the laser blade that continued to emit its strange hum.
Look, look, there! Fish! Swimming! Lots!
Clear pointed to the waterfall's pool with the tip of her blade.
Yata also noisily flapped her wings in a show of excitement.
Indeed, there were several fish swimming in the deeply gouged pool.
Don't tell me you actually intend to stick that thing into the water, Clear.
Yukikaze taught me. She said make it buzz, lots of fish float.
...Of course she did, that little buzz brain.
It was great that she liked to take care of people, but what was she teaching these children?
Listen, Clear. The fish will float for sure, but shocking the water's not a good way to play.
Clear tilted her head, and Yata likewise also looked puzzled.
That's not playing in the river, that's just hunting fish. And on top of that, it's prohibited by law. It will destroy the river for no reason.
It you're going to play, use a fishing rod. If not, catch them by hand. That's the nice way to play in the river.
Though it didn't seem to quite get through to her, Clear turned off her blade.
Yata was flapping her wings as if she wanted to say something.
Asking if feather shuriken are bad.
Clear, who for some reason seemed able to understand her, translated for me.
Hmm... Feather shuriken, huh. It's not good to throw a bunch at once and catch them all in one go. If you target one at a time, it's alright.
Yata, seeming to also understand, had given a couple nods of her black bird head.
『*Yawwwwwn.* Did we reach the river yet, Fuma-kun?』
I suddenly heard Sakura's sleepy yawning voice coming from my shadow.
I thought that it had been strangely quiet for some time, and it seemed that she'd been napping in my shadow.
Oh, if it isn't Clear-chan and Yata-chan!
When Sakura noticed the two of them, she jumped out of my shadow as if she'd been flicked out.
The two were very excited by Sakura's appearance.
Sakura also raised her voice in a cheer without so much as thanking me for walking all the way for her.
Let's all go play in the river!
Hey, hey, river play♪ River play♪
In the end, the three ended up joining hands and started to dance a strange river-play dance.
Freeloaders sure do get along well together.
Aaalright! Now, Sakura onee-chan's gonna teach you the secret to catching river crabs!
They'd apparently decided to catch crabs, not fish.
As soon as she said that, Sakura put her hands on the hem of her uniform.
Was she going to change there!?
She all of a sudden threw off her uniform, and then...
Damn, so she was wearing it underneath?
Sakura shot a smirk in my direction.
Ahhh! Maybe you were expecting me to go skinny-dipping in the river!?
Wh-Why would I ever expect that!?
Sakura pointed an accusatory finger at me.
Yata followed their lead, probably calling me a lecher as well.
I was being treated as if I was some kind of perverted freak.
At that same time, at a small stream a short distance awayー
This is a Nisha matter. Leave.
Shizuku and Saburo were squaring off against one another.
However, there was yet another man to whom Saburo was talking.
Such brazen talk for ones that have invaded Gosha territory...
It was Taimanin Library, who'd pursued Shizuku here.
Not only had he found Shizuku but Saburo as well, and now his Oniwaban subordinates were cautiously surrounding the two.
Why'd you bring someone like him here, Shizuku?
This old man's really stubborn. I don't know why, but he follows me wherever I go.
That's because you're not good enough.
Kids would never understand anything unless they're told.
I don't wanna hear that from you, Saburo!
I really am fed up with you.
Library spoke with slight astonishment at the two fighting like children.
You're both members of Nisha, right? And you told me you're the son of Kuroki.
And you there. That demonic spider reminds me of someone... Are you Onigumo Saburo's grandchild? You have his looks.
You know my grandfather? Who are you?
Saburo's eyes widened at Library, who'd realized her identity at a glance.
I used to be comrade-in-arms with your grandfather.
So you know him. I see.
He said he was with my father, too. Seems like this old man must really be old.
I won't deny that. And that's why I can't bring myself to kill young people like you.
Perhaps you two could just come quietly?
I refuse. Interfere and you'll be food for Daigoro.
And with that, a bloodlust swirled in the air around Shizuku, Saburo, Library, and the Oniwaban.
